subject: Pioneer Health — Admin activation, API key seeding & seat mapping
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Sara Alvarez <sara.alvarez@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Luis Gomez <luis.gomez@pioneerhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pioneer Health — Admin activation, API key seeding & seat mapping

Hi Sara,

Great to meet you yesterday — thanks for the time. Per our call, the first step we usually take is a short "activation sprint" to establish admin recipients, seed the initial API keys for the project namespace, and confirm seat/role mapping so your security team has the right guardrails.

Proposed high-level plan (30/60/90 minute commitments):
- Today: confirm three admin contacts + preferred invite order (we send invites in waves).
- Tomorrow AM: Redwood to provision sandbox API keys and seed the project in your us-west region.
- By EOD tomorrow: CS will share the runbook and a seat-mapping template for your IT/security to review.

Can you confirm the two admin contacts (name + email) we should invite first? Also looping procurement and your security contacts will help speed the SOC2 evidence/retention discussion.

Attachments: I have a draft runbook and key-request template ready — I can attach once we confirm scope.

Thanks,
Sean
Sean Gallagher | Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Onboarding & Implementation

Hi Sean — thanks, this looks good.

Confirming initial admin contacts:
- Sara Alvarez (me) — sara.alvarez@pioneerhealth.com
- Luis Gomez — luis.gomez@pioneerhealth.com

Our security lead (cc'd) will want the seat mapping and the API key rotation policy documented. Procurement is on copy for the contract schedule and PO. Please seed a sandbox key only — we will not start production traffic until contract signature.

1) What TTL/rotation cadence do you recommend for seeded sandbox keys?
2) Can we get the runbook with the list of RBAC roles you create so our IAM team can pre-approve?

Thanks,

Pioneer Health

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>

Monica / Karthik — looping you both to coordinate the activation sprint for Pioneer Health (RDW-2026-0457). Sara confirmed admin contacts and wants sandbox only for now. Procurement is on copy.

Quick internal checklist: please reply inline with ownership
- Monica: seed sandbox project in us-west, create one sandbox API key with rotation TTL set to 30 days (customer asks) and mark as scoped to "dev" namespace. Tag key: RDW-PIONEER-SBX-1.
- Karthik: prepare the RBAC matrix and the seat-mapping spreadsheet for Sara's IAM review; include default roles (Org Admin, Project Admin, Viewer, Auditor) and a minimal SRE role.
- Sean (me): send the runbook and schedule the 30-minute activation call tomorrow 09:00 PT if those times work.

Attach the template for API-key-request and seat map in my follow-up.

Thanks team — want to get Pioneer into sandbox by tomorrow morning.

Sean

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Sean — done on the sandbox project provisioning. Details:
- Project: pioneer-health-sbx (us-west)
- Namespace: pioneer-health-dev
- Seeded API key: RDW-PIONEER-SBX-1 (scoped to read/write in dev namespace). TTL set to 30 days; rotation note added to key metadata.

Attached: seat-mapping-template.xlsx and api-key-request-template.csv (fillable). Karthik, I left comments in the RBAC matrix on recommended least-privilege roles and suggestions for two-step role elevation for your SREs.

Next steps for Pioneer (actionable):
- Sara/Luis: confirm which users map to the columns in seat-mapping-template.xlsx (Admin wave 1: Sara, Luis).
- Procurement: confirm PO timeline so we can convert sandbox keys to production keys post-signature.
- Redwood: schedule 30-min activation call tomorrow 09:00 PT (I can lead the live key rotation demo).

Attachments: pioneer_onboard_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook), api-key-request-template.csv, seat-mapping-template.xlsx

Monica Patel
Customer Success Engineer | Redwood Inference
